Specification: This file contains two TLA+ modules. The main module models a one-variable boolean system in which the single state variable b starts as FALSE and the only explicit next-state action sets b' = TRUE. It defines several alternative specifications and temporal properties to contrast behavior with and without fairness: one spec has only Init and a boxed next-state formula, another adds weak fairness on Next, and another instead includes an eventuality property directly. The file also defines safety, liveness, leads-to, recurrence, and persistence formulas, and includes refinement-style references to a second module H via INSTANCE. The nested module H provides separate specifications over its own variable b using BOOLEAN-valued steps and weak fairness, but inherited constructs from H are not extracted into the main module's imported fields except for the explicit INSTANCE occurrence in the main module.
